name: servers
one_liner: Official example code showing developers how to connect AI assistants to outside tools and data, like a set of blueprints rather than a finished product.
buyer: A software developer learning to build integrations between AI assistants and their company's internal tools or data sources.
business_use_cases: A dev team studies the reference servers to build a custom internal MCP server connecting their AI assistant to their own CRM.
A consultancy uses the examples as a starting point when building paid custom AI integrations for clients.
A tooling vendor benchmarks its own MCP server implementation against the official reference for compatibility.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid custom MCP server development for companies who want their internal tools connected to AI assistants but lack in-house expertise.
Run a training workshop teaching developers to build production-grade MCP servers using these references as the curriculum.

steal_this: This weekend, pick one under-served niche (e.g. a popular CRM or accounting tool with no MCP server yet) and ship a polished MCP server for it, then offer it as a paid plugin to that tool's user base.
